decision_conditions:
<p><span style="line-height: 115%;">The proposed
first floor rear extensions, by reason of its&nbsp;flat roof design, would give
rise to a visually obtrusive and incongruous form of development that would be
harmful to the character and appearance of the subject dwellings and the local
area, contrary to the high quality design aspirations set out in the National
Planning Policy Framework (2024), policy D3.D (11) of The London Plan (2021),
policy CS1.B on the Harrow Core Strategy (2012), policy DM1 of the Development
Management Local Plans Policies (2013) and adopted Supplementary Planning
Document: Residential Design Guide (2010) and the draft Harrow Local Plan GR1.</span></p>

<p><span style="line-height: 115%;">The proposed
first floor rear extension would, by reason of its excessive scale, bulk and poor
design, give rise to a dominant and
incongruous form of development, which subsumes the original dwellinghouse and fails to respect the host dwellings proportions, scale or character. The development is
therefore contrary to the high quality design aspirations set out in the
National Planning Policy Framework (2024), Policy D3 (D(1) and D(11)) of The
London Plan (2021), policy CS1.B on the Harrow Core Strategy (2012), Policy DM1
of the Development Management Local Plans Policies (2013) and adopted
Supplementary Planning Document: Residential Design Guide (2010) and the draft
Harrow Local Plan GR1.</span></p>

<p><span style="line-height: 115%;">The first
floor rear extension at no. 50 Norman Crescent by reason of its excessive rearward projection, and
siting in close proximity to No. 48 Norman Crescent would give rise to overshadowing and an&nbsp; overbearing visual impact to the detriment of the residential
and visual amenities of the occupiers of this neighbouring property. The proposal would therefore be contrary
to National Planning Policy Framework (2024), Policy D3 (D(1) and D(11)) of The
London Plan (2021), policy CS1.B on the Harrow Core Strategy (2012), Policy DM1
of the Development Management Local Plans Policies (2013) and adopted
Supplementary Planning Document: Residential Design Guide (2010) and the draft
Harrow Local Plan GR1.</span></p>
